t: This is the National Secular Society, a British campaigning organisation that promotes secularism and the separation of church and state. Its position is that nobody should gain an advantage or a disadvantage because of their religion, or lack of one. It was founded in 1866 by Charles Bradlaugh, a freethinker, politician and atheism activist. He set it up fifteen years after George Holyoake coined the word secularism, in 1851.
